E1268

`jet image <name>` cannot use remote OCI reference `<ref>`.

What

`jet image <name>` cannot use remote OCI reference `<ref>`.

Why

D-JPK-IMAGE1: local OCI layouts are copied only after digest validation; remote registry transport is a separate trust boundary and is never faked.

Fix

use `--push file:///path/to/layout`, or configure a verified registry transport.
